summary.intent: Find out why Entire reported no token usage for the last 7 days despite running Claude and Codex sessions, then fix the checkpoint setup and sync gaps in Callisto and the other Entire-linked repos.
summary.outcome: Condensed the stuck Claude session and pushed 179 Callisto checkpoint refs plus 1,714 refs across agent-plugins, monokl and oxc-react-docgen to origin, and reinstalled stale hooks in all five repos. Michi's one missing ref is blocked by GitHub secret scanning, Codex hook approval is still pending in four repos, and the Entire UI still showed no refreshed token data when last checked.

repo: `entire tokens profile` aggregates only committed checkpoint metadata, so active sessions with tokens in `entire status` won't appear in the report until their checkpoint is committed.

Callisto's committed .entire/settings.json had `push_sessions: false`; the working copy set it to true but was uncommitted. Entire's account activity showed no Callisto sessions after Sep 21 while local sessions continued, which fits this setting.

Entire stores checkpoints as individual git refs under refs/entire/checkpoints/<shard>/<id>, normally synced by its push hook. A single missing checkpoint can be pushed with an explicit refspec, and `git ls-remote origin <ref>` verifies it.
Ordering matters: a branch push does not carry checkpoints condensed afterwards. The Claude session was condensed at 16:13, after the 16:11 branch push, so its ref never reached origin.

`entire doctor` offers Condense for ended sessions with uncondensed data, and `--force` can discard sessions it cannot condense. Condensing raised the Claude session's token record from 221.9M with no breakdown to 707.8M with input, cache, output and API-call counts.
PR stacking and rebases can trigger attribution-divergence warnings but were not why records were missing; the cause was checkpoint refs absent from origin.
Checkpoint refs contain session and transcript data, which can include secrets: Michi's checkpoint held an npm access token and GitHub secret scanning rejected the push.
Hook reinstall clears Claude, OpenCode and Copilot warnings, but Codex hook approval is separate and must be done inside the Codex app.

code.finding: Committed `push_sessions: false` disables session reporting; the uncommitted working-copy edit sets it to true and enables checkpoint pushes. It must be committed to persist.

workflow: Network access to github.com and Entire login needed elevated permissions in the sandbox; remote queries failed with DNS errors until run with elevation.

Pushing session or transcript metadata to a remote is data egress. Automatic review blocked these pushes until the user explicitly approved each destination, and approval for Callisto did not extend to other repos.
Compare local refs against remotes with `git ls-remote` before pushing, and leave refs whose local and remote hashes differ untouched.
Do not bypass GitHub secret scanning; report the blocked ref instead.

friction: `entire search` required an Entire login, which blocked the initial seven-day history check.
The assistant gave the wrong catch-up order (push first, then condense), so the Claude checkpoint never reached origin.
The first checkpoint push was rejected by automatic review, and the assistant should have raised the data-transfer boundary before saying it would push.
The user had to remind the assistant to use elevation more than once.
The in-app browser failed on a missing support module, so the UI token page could not be inspected.
The account activity API does not expose token fields, so UI refresh could not be confirmed.
Codex hook approval cannot be controlled from this environment.
GitHub secret scanning blocked Michi's checkpoint upload because of an npm token.
open_items: Michi's one missing checkpoint ref is blocked because its session data contains an npm access token. Rotate or revoke the token and redact or rewrite the checkpoint before retrying the push.
Approve the pending Codex hooks in the Codex app for agent-plugins, michi, monokl and oxc-react-docgen.
Investigate 4 oxc-react-docgen refs and 1 Michi ref where local and remote hashes differ; they were left untouched.
Commit .entire/settings.json with `push_sessions: true` if the setting should persist.
Trace why the Entire UI still shows no token data after the refs were pushed. This needs the page URL or a screenshot.
Callisto still has an attribution-divergence warning, and oxc-react-docgen has a session reporting possible attribution skew after history movement.
Claude's 221.9M to 707.8M token record shows earlier uncondensed data was undercounted; confirm totals in the UI once it refreshes.
Check whether hooks are healthy on future runs, since many repos had stale hooks.
